paper_title: Production rates of dark photons and $Z'$ in the Sun and stellar cooling bounds
notes: Paper derives stellar cooling (Solar, HB, RG) bounds on U(1) gauge bosons for dark photon, B-L, Lmu-Ltau, Le-Lmu(tau) models. Extracted the B-L solar cooling bound explicitly quoted in conclusions: gZ' < 4.1e-10 for mZ' <~ 10 keV, encoded as a flat two-point line over the low-mass plateau (figure range extends down to ~1e-4 eV). The bound criterion is dEloss/dt < 10% L_sun (an energy-loss argument, not a statistical CL; 0.95 is nominal). The paper also constrains Le-Lmu(tau) (gZ' < 3.9e-11) and dark photon kinetic mixing, but per the B-L hint and enum, VectorBL data is reported. Stronger RG/HB bounds exist only in figures (not digitized).
